question: In which year was the provision for the free legal aid to the poor added to the Directive Principles of the State Policy of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision for **free legal aid to the poor** was added to the **Directive Principles of State Policy** in the Indian Constitution through the **42nd Amendment Act of 1976**.
 
• This amendment introduced **Article 39A**, which directs the State to promote justice on the basis of equal opportunity and provide free legal aid to ensure that no citizen is denied access to justice due to economic or other disabilities.
 
• The **Directive Principles of State Policy** (DPSP) are non-justiciable guidelines for the government to ensure socio-economic welfare and justice.
 
• The 42nd Amendment is often referred to as the **“Mini Constitution”** because it introduced significant changes to the Constitution, including provisions related to education, environment, and justice.
 
• This amendment played a crucial role in strengthening the **welfare state** ideology and ensuring social justice for marginalized sections of society.
 
• The concept of free legal aid was influenced by the United Nations’ **Declaration of Human Rights**, which emphasizes equal access to justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1978**__

 __
 
• This year is significant for the **44th Amendment Act**, which reversed some provisions of the 42nd Amendment but did not relate to free legal aid.
 
• The 44th Amendment restored certain rights and protections, such as the provision for property rights under Article 300A.
 
 
 
• **2011**__
 __
 
• No major constitutional amendments related to free legal aid or Directive Principles occurred in this year.
 
• This year is more associated with **judicial and legislative developments**, such as the introduction of certain social welfare schemes and acts.
 
 
 
• **2002**__
 
 
• The **86th Amendment Act** was passed in this year, which added the provision for free and compulsory education for children under Article 21A.
 
• This amendment was important for education but had no connection to free legal aid.
